$comment: CPE-1594 ratchet. A spec listed here is ALLOWED to fail; anything else failing reds the job. Removing an entry is one-way: once a spec passes, the ratchet FAILS until it is deleted from this list. See gui-smoke/README.md 'Reading a CI run' for the exact procedure to retire an entry.

samples.smoke.ts.reason: preview pane never settles for ~15 sample kinds (crypto/*, .eml, .ics, .vcf, .json) on WebKitGTK after 20s

saved-search.smoke.ts.reason: Saved Searches sidebar header never renders on Linux; .fav-title getText() returns empty

network.smoke.ts.reason: CPE-1595 CONFIRMED (not just a theory): the .fav-title + getText() selector is correct and the header DOES paint — the run-31449236678 failure screenshot (network-fail.png) shows 'Network' rendered, visible, on-screen at the exact moment the 15s wait timed out. getText() nonetheless returned something other than 'Network' for every retry in that window. Same symptom as saved-search.smoke.ts (CPE-1507): a WebKitGTK/Xvfb classic-WebDriver GetElementText quirk for this Sidebar.svelte '<span class="label fav-title">' header shape, not a rendering gap, not a selector bug (Sidebar.test.ts's jsdom render passes) and not fixable by another selector change. Left listed pending a WebKitGTK-specific investigation (root cause still open); see CPE-1507.

archive-browse.smoke.ts.reason: CPE-1595: real failure (job 93649941153) was 'expected a file row containing CPE-1181-archive.tar.gz: expected false to equal true' from a ONE-SHOT row scan that only waited for the breadcrumb, not for the (docs/design/STREAMING.md) batched listing to finish streaming ~30 root fixtures under CI load — not the generic 'click intercepted' this entry used to say. Hardened with a browser.waitUntil retry in this PR's spec fix; left listed pending a live green run before deletion.

archive-password.smoke.ts.reason: CPE-1595: real failure (job 93649941153) was 'WebDriverError: move target out of bounds' from mouse.ts's Actions-fallback rightClick, right after pointOfRow computed a point for the CPE-1181-archive.tar.gz row via scrollIntoView+150ms-pause — the point had gone stale (or the scroll hadn't settled) by the time the pointer command reached WebKitWebDriver. Hardened pointOfRow with an in-bounds re-check-and-retry loop in this PR; left listed pending a live green run before deletion.

shred-dialog.smoke.ts.reason: CPE-1595: genuine PRODUCT BUG, fixed here across two rounds (see CPE-1601, still open). Round 1: ContextMenu.svelte's onMount only repositioned '.ctx' to keep its TOP-LEFT on-screen, never accounting for the menu's own height exceeding the viewport (shred-dialog-fail.png shows 'Securely delete…' pushed off the bottom, permanently unreachable since '.ctx' had no scroll container for scrollIntoView() to use) — fixed with 'max-height'+'overflow-y:auto' on '.ctx'. Round 2 (caught by UAT + independent review before merge): that made '.ctx' clip BOTH axes (CSS Overflow spec: a visible axis computes to auto once the other isn't), clipping Submenu.svelte's '.flyout' (New ▸/Run macro ▸/etc, an absolutely-positioned descendant escaping via left:100%) to nothing on every context menu, not just tall ones — fixed by making '.flyout' position:fixed, anchored to its parent row's rect in JS, escaping '.ctx''s clip entirely. Verified in real Chrome (short/tall-scrolled/right-edge-flip scenarios + a negative control proving the repro catches the original bug); jsdom guard added; gui-smoke's own macro-in-menu.smoke.ts strengthened to assert real flyout geometry, not just DOM existence. Left listed pending a live green run before deletion (out-of-scope to verify tauri-driver locally).

transfer-panel.smoke.ts.reason: CPE-1595: real failure (job 93649941153) was 'expected a row for the seeded CPE-1226-transfer-panel-folder: expected null to not equal null' on the SPEC'S VERY FIRST navigation step — the same batch-streaming race archive-browse.smoke.ts hit (one-shot pointOfRow call right after crumb.waitForExist, no retry for the listing to finish streaming), which then cascades into the spec's other two tests never reaching their own preconditions. Hardened with a browser.waitUntil retry in this PR's spec fix; left listed pending a live green run before deletion.
